findings.detail: Important, below Critical; reported under the explicit verdict-classification stop. A test can print a nested unittest report ending in OK (skipped=1) to stdout while its outer suite produces a valid result on stderr. Combining the streams makes the nested summary an outer verdict, rejecting valid baseline or named assertion evidence and blocking publication. Skipped because this pass is report-only.
findings.evidence: matches concatenates stdout and stderr at line 171. framework_lines retains summaries preceding the first exception separator at line 151, or every summary when no separator exists. Thus a nested skipped summary on stdout survives selection and returns an empty status list at lines 154–155, even when stderr contains the correct outer summary. The existing nested-diagnostic test covers reports after an exception separator, not this sibling.
findings.title: Uncited: Nested stdout reports still determine the outer verdict
